lines.text: One day...
You'll wish you started today.
You'll wish you started going to the gym.
You'll wish you started learning that skill.
You'll wish you stopped wasting hours scrolling.
But here's the problem.
You're waiting.
Waiting until Monday.
Waiting until the new year.
Waiting until you feel motivated.
Waiting until life gets easier.
But what if that perfect moment never comes?
What if the only thing standing between you, and the person you want to become...
Is the decision you're avoiding today?
Think about it.
A year from now, you could be in exactly the same position.
Making the same excuses.
Living the same routine.
Or...
You could be looking back at today, grateful that you finally started.
You don't need a perfect plan.
You don't need to feel ready.
You just need to take the first step.
Because the best time to start was yesterday.
The second best time is today.
The next version.
